# SportsDataIO

> > SportsDataIO provides comprehensive sports data APIs, real-time betting odds, and the BAKER Predictive Engine for developers building sports analytics, fantasy sports, and sports betting applications.

SportsDataIO delivers live and historical sports data feeds across NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, NCAA, and WNBA with specialized tools including the SportsDataIO Vault for historical odds, SportsDataIO GRid for real-time data, and the BAKER Predictive Engine for odds origination. The platform serves developers, sportsbooks, media companies, and fantasy sports operators with RESTful APIs and comprehensive data dictionaries.

## Key Topics

- SportsDataIO Core Sports Data API
- BAKER Predictive Engine
- Betting Odds API and historical odds
- Fantasy Sports API and player projections
- SportsDataIO Vault (historical data)
- SportsDataIO GRid (real-time feeds)
- NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, NCAA, WNBA coverage
- API integration and workflow guides
- Live & Final subfeeds
- Scrambled data vs premium subscriptions
- Tournament brackets and March Madness
- Coded Content and betting metadata
- Sports data feeds for SEO and marketing
- Game simulations for testing

## Getting Started & Developer Resources

- [Getting Started with Sports Data APIs | SportsDataIO](https://sportsdata.io/developers): Developer portal for API integration across NFL, MLB, NBA, NHL coverage
- [Live & Final Subfeed Explained](https://sportsdata.io/help/live-and-final): Guide to Live & Final vs Final subfeeds for real-time and post-game data
- [Scrambled Data](https://sportsdata.io/help/scrambled-data): Explains scrambled data in free trials vs premium API subscriptions
- [Sports Data API Live Game Simulations | SportsDataIO](https://sportsdata.io/developers/sports-data-api-live-game-simulations): Guide to NFL API game simulations for offseason testing and development

## Core Products & Services

- [BAKER Engine - Sports data predictions](https://sportsdata.io/baker-predictive-engine): BAKER Predictive Engine for odds origination and fantasy contest creation
- [BAKER Engine Resources | Introduction & Testing | SportsDataIO](https://sportsdata.io/developers/baker-engine): Getting started guide for BAKER Predictive Engine API integration
- [NHL Data API | NHL Historical Data | Sports Data Feeds | SportsDataIO](https://sportsdata.io/nhl-api): NHL live and historical data API with real-time stats and betting odds
- [Historical Odds](https://sportsdata.io/historical-odds): SportsDataIO Vault historical betting odds database for AI and analytics
